audit.whatIsWrong: HARD at 7.5/10 contradicts both the data and the page's own chart: 48.96% over 192 games, with Aurora given five of seven stages.
audit.why: 192 games is a solid sample and 49% is a coin flip, not a 7.5/10 counter.
audit.corrected: Nearer EVEN at 6/10, with the difficulty concentrated on his Unstoppable Force windows rather than the lane.

audit.why: Malphite owns Level 1 behind Granite Shield and Seismic Shard, Aurora takes 3-5 once her leap and sustain are online, and 6 onward swings on whether his ult is up. That matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive facts are absent. Ground Slam deals damage based on his ARMOR, so the armour he buys against everyone else is damage aimed at you — 'build pen' is only half the answer. And Granite Shield recharges only if he has not been hit for a few seconds, so continuous chip keeps it permanently down.
audit.why: Riot's text: E 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'; P 'If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.'
audit.corrected: Chip him on a rhythm rather than in bursts — Granite Shield never comes back while you keep landing Twofold Hex. And expect his Ground Slam to hit harder the more armour he stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] and the mid breakdown both say the R rift lets Aurora 'walk untargetable through walls' as the answer to Unstoppable Force. Between Worlds gives no untargetability, and it does not pass through terrain.
audit.why: Riot's text: Between Worlds creates an area that slows enemies within it and lets Aurora teleport from one side of the area to the other. It is a zone-crossing teleport, not a wall phase and not immunity.
audit.corrected: The answer to his engage is the leap and the rift's slow plus the cross — you move out of his landing spot, you do not become untargetable in it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers. Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 — the longest enemy cooldown in this slice and the whole shape of the matchup — and it is never stated.
audit.why: Malphite Q 8s flat, W 10s, E 7s flat, R 130/115/100.
audit.corrected: Unstoppable Force 130s at rank 1; Seismic Shard 8s; Ground Slam 7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The TL;DR says 'build pen' as the counter to his resistances, and spikes[2] says his armour is 'useless vs your full-AP kit'. Ground Slam converting armour into damage makes that read wrong.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'.
audit.corrected: His armour is never useless against you — it is the scaling on the ability he uses to trade with you.

notes: champ-data/_kits/malphite.json carries grounding flags on Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E). Riot's descriptions for both mention no grounding — Q steals Move Speed, E reduces Attack Speed — so per the brief I trusted the descriptions and wrote no grounding claim. If Malphite genuinely grounds, that would matter enormously to Aurora (both her W and R are dashes) and is worth a targeted check. The 'untargetable' error corrected here is champion-wide: 61 occurrences in champ-data/content/aurora.js.
